alisa: Quick heads-up 1 we're evaluating Quokka-6B-compact (LSQ 3-bit) for a low-latency chat tier. Before we expose anything externally: legal check on redistribution / sublicensing for quantized weights + whether a tiny UI credit is sufficient.

ben: perf summary - 3-bit LSQ reduces median latency ~2.2x and token cost ~2.4x. Quality deltas: microbench shows -2.9% on long-form coherence, +0.2% on instruction-following. Safety filter false-positive rate up +0.4%.

alisa: the upstream repo has a somewhat unusual clause about "sublicense" and "downstream artifacts". I pasted the snippet below.

deploy-bot: ```
QUOKKA LICENSE 1.0
- Noncommercial research allowed.
- Redistribution of model binaries or Derivative Works is permitted only with explicit upstream approval.
- Upstream grants no sublicenses; any downstream service that embeds the Model (or Derivative) must carry explicit attribution and cannot relicense the Model.
- Hosting for remuneration requires a separate commercial agreement.
```

maria (legal): flagged items: "no sublicenses" + "downstream service that embeds the Model" both matter. Two questions we need to answer from engineering: (A) does our quantized runtime + in-memory copy count as a "Derivative" or "embedded" Model? (B) does serving outputs to paying customers constitute "hosting for remuneration"? Short answer: likely yes to both, but need exact wording.

henry: technical nuance: we don't distribute the quant file; runtime holds tensors in memory per request. We also don't include the upstream model in any redistributable artifact. Is that materially different?

maria (legal): likely not. Licenses often intend to capture both redistribution and commercial hosting. "No sublicenses" means we can't relicense the model under our TOS. Attribution: we can add a small credit in Console model card and include full notice in docs. But the bigger hurdle is hosting.

alisa: product-side UX Q: would adding an endpoint-level header like `X-Model-Attribution: Quokka-6B-compact (Quokka Labs)` + model card be reasonable compliance? Or do they expect visible branding in the UI?

maria (legal): HTTP headers alone might not satisfy a visible attribution requirement. We should plan for (1) model metadata card in Console with name + license link, and (2) 'powered by' string in the model selector. Headers are fine for audit traces but not user-visible attribution.

henry: outreach note: we should prepare a technical appendix: exact quant method (LSQ 3-bit, per-channel scale, no weight pruning), storage (encrypted shards, no public artifacts), runtime behavior (in-memory only), and fallback (auto-fallback to FP16). Also include the canary rollout plan and telemetry retention limits.

ben: also include benchmark delta table vs FP16 and our safety mitigations (extra classifier pass). We'll propose a conservative attribution string and offer to add telemetry/usage reporting to upstream if they want.

maria (legal): suggested outreach asks: (A) confirm whether quantized in-memory runtime is treated as a "Derivative"; (B) request a commercial hosting license or carve-out for paid API; (C) confirm acceptable attribution language and placement; (D) whether we can offer the quantized variant to Dedicated customers under Redwood-managed infra or if it must be BYO in Private/VPC.

alisa: timeline: we can keep Quokka-6B-compact for internal/eval-only. If upstream okays hosting, we want to enable canary in 2 weeks.

henry: technical mitigation if hosting is denied: offer automated FP16 fallback and a BYO path (customer uploads model to Private and runs quant there). For Dedicated managed, we'll block until license cleared.

deploy-bot: policy reminder: set onboarding sheet `legal` = pending and `hosted` = blocked.

maria (legal): action items: 1) alisa attach the full LICENSE file + commit hash to onboarding folder; 2) henry prepare the technical appendix + hash of quant pipeline; 3) ben attach perf/regression CSV and safety bench; 4) maria + legal will draft outreach and propose wording. We'll target initial contact EOD Fri.

alisa: done - uploaded artifacts to /onboard/quokka-6b-compact (internal). tagging @maria when draft ready. :pray:

ben: one more note: Quokka authors have been responsive historically, happy path probability ~60%. If they want revenue share terms, product can scope.

alisa: thanks. leaving thread open for followups.
